in_sanskrit.name: ज्ञानान्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ज्ञानम् अन्श: ज्ञान + अन्श = wisdom + wealth

in_marathi.name: Gyanansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gyanansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'gyan' meaning knowledge and 'ansh' meaning the embodiment. It signifies the one who is the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, this name is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
